create_dataflow_graph: create a dataflow graph using model_opt.dataflow_graph.Graph for representing computation dependencies
add_nodes_to_graph: add named nodes to a dataflow graph using graph.add_node to represent model operations
add_edges_between_nodes: add edges between nodes with size attributes using graph.add_edge to represent tensor dependencies
canonicalize_graph: canonicalize a dataflow graph using graph.canonicalize to normalize its structure
build_multi_fanin_graph: build a multi fan-in dataflow graph where a node has multiple incoming edges from different sources
